preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 1000 for n in test_case_ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of nodes n is an integer between 2 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes u and v within the range [1, n].
The edges form a valid tree structure (connected, acyclic, n-1 edges).

preconditions.expression: 1 <= s <= n and 1 <= f <= n and s != f
preconditions.description: The hidden nodes s and f are distinct integers within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The output pair of guessed nodes matches the set of the two hidden nodes {s, f}.
The total number of queries made for the test case does not exceed 14.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, int) and 1 <= node <= n for node in guessed_nodes)
postconditions.description: The guessed nodes are valid integers within the range [1, n].
